name: Blood Nova
desc: Tammy's Head fires 10 Brimstone beams at once — the room dies instantly.

name: Techno Brimstone
desc: A constant heavy laser with no charge time: Technology firing with Brimstone power.

name: Guided Ring of Death
desc: A steerable blood ring you can park right on top of a boss.

name: Rings of Hell
desc: Ring lasers gain Brimstone's damage and appearance.

name: Sulfur Bomb
desc: The charged shot becomes a huge explosive sulfur ball with massive damage.

name: Beam Trap
desc: Hold fire to place hovering beams, then release them all at once.

name: Void Ray
desc: Both charge together: a blood beam surrounded by a soul-stealing black ring.

name: Explosive Shotgun
desc: A volley of 14 explosive shots. One charge — one deleted room.

name: Painless Bomber
desc: Your explosive tears no longer hurt you — they heal you instead.

name: Explosive Machine Gun
desc: A rapid stream of tiny explosive tears. Chaos that works for you.

name: Point-Blank Nuke
desc: Triple-damage explosive tears up close — bosses melt in seconds.

name: Straight Shot
desc: Tractor Beam flattens Ipecac's arc into a safe, precise straight line.

name: Guided Missiles
desc: Homing explosive shots that chase enemies around corners.

name: Heavy Ordnance
desc: One colossal explosive shot with absurd combined damage.

name: Blast Shield
desc: Host Hat blocks explosions — including your own Ipecac blasts.

name: Spider Nest
desc: A wall of 8+ tears every shot. Nothing gets through.

name: Heaven's Wrath
desc: Homing divine tears with damage auras and enormous damage.

name: Twin Halos
desc: Two Godhead tears — two overlapping damage auras per shot.

name: Remote Fetus
desc: Mine the whole room with bomb-tears and detonate everything with one press.

name: Bomb Diet
desc: Every bomb-tear that hits you heals you. Walk through your own minefield.

name: Seeker Bombs
desc: Your bomb-tears home in on enemies by themselves.

name: Danger Close
desc: Call in air strikes on your own position with zero risk.

name: Seraph's Blade
desc: Every sword swing fires beams of holy light across the room.

name: Orbital Laser
desc: The controlled tear projects a laser ring that damages everything around it.

name: Chain Reaction
desc: Bursting tears split, and the splits split again. A shrapnel storm.

name: Endless Split
desc: Every tear fragments on impact into even more tears.

name: Guppy Transformation
desc: Three Guppy items turn Isaac into Guppy: flight + blue flies on every hit.

name: Fun Guy Transformation
desc: Three mushroom items: +1 heart and the Fun Guy form.

name: Beelzebub Transformation
desc: Three fly items: flight, and enemy flies become friendly.
